Zed

the Master of Shadows
Mid laneJungle lane

Zed is the classic assassin: he uses shadows to throw shurikens from two or three places at once, then marks a target with his ultimate and deletes them. He's a skill-shot and timing champion who punishes squishy carries. Zed is played mostly in mid, and sometimes in the jungle.

When to pick Zed

✓ Safe blind pick

Fairly safe blind: he can poke and farm with shadows against most mids, though Malphite and armor-stacking picks are tough.

Pick into

  • Squishy, immobile mages like Orianna or Cassiopeia
  • Enemy teams with squishy carries and few Zhonya's Hourglass users
  • Slow, late-game mids he can punish early, like Galio
  • Teams without much point-and-click crowd control

Avoid into

  • Tanky mids like Malphite who ignore his damage
  • Champions with resets and outplays, like Katarina
  • Teams with several tanks and armor
  • Mids who build Zhonya's Hourglass early

Great teammates

Lee SinEarly ganks and kicks set up Zed's burst.
LeonaHer engage locks targets for his mark.
OrnnA strong frontline lets Zed find the backline.

Your team needs: Some magic damage and a frontline, since Zed is physical burst only.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Living Shadow lets him poke from safe angles and swap to escape
  • Death Mark makes him untargetable and lets him burst one target from range
  • Huge damage against squishy mages and marksmen
  • Uses energy, so he can poke all lane without running out of mana

Weaknesses

  • Weak against tanks and champions who build armor early
  • Point-and-click crowd control and Zhonya's Hourglass ruin his ultimate
  • Hard to master: missing shadow Qs means losing lane
  • Falls off if he can't snowball

Power spikes

  • Level 3: W + E + Q poke wins trades against squishy mids.
  • Level 6: Death Mark makes almost any squishy enemy a kill target.
  • First item (Voltaic Cyclosword): fast energy-cheap burst; you can start roaming.
  • Two items (Bastionbreaker): more lethality and damage to structures (nerfed in 26.21, but still core).
  • Three items (Lord Dominik's Regards): cut through armor late game.

Top tips

  • Watch for the enemy's Zhonya's Hourglass: if they stasis during your mark, swap back out and wait.
  • Place your W behind the enemy so swapping cuts off their escape.
  • Death Mark dodges almost any ability; use it to dodge a big ultimate if you have to.
  • Don't poke with W if the enemy jungler is missing; it's your only escape.
  • Overlap shurikens from you and your shadow for double damage.
  • Against tanky teams, build Serylda's Grudge or Lord Dominik's Regards sooner.
